quality_rules: One canonical URL per independent search intent
Smaller questions remain article sections rather than separate URLs
No SKU in general educational URLs
Every subcategory receives at least two core-usefulness articles
SEO expansion pages must represent a distinct question, comparison, troubleshooting need, or navigation intent
Existing Alle's ClinX pages must be reviewed before publishing overlapping Library articles
Chemical-safety content stays informational and defers product-specific use to controlled labels/SDS/TDS
research_basis: Alle's ClinX public sitemap, support centre, document centre, sector solution pages and current learning content
Professional-cleaning knowledge structures used by major industry providers
Search-intent separation between definitions, comparisons, troubleshooting, planning and reference questions
Google Search guidance favouring useful, descriptive, non-duplicative content and logical internal linking
meta.word_count_note: Word-count ranges are editorial planning ranges, not Google ranking requirements. Publish when the search intent is fully answered without padding.
